extracted.name: Rice recipes - rice meal recipes for dinner
extracted.description: Here's a quick link list of the rice recipes listed in this post! I've also included directions for how to cook plain white rice, just for convenience.
ingredient_lines: One Pot Greek Chicken and Lemon Rice
One Pan Chicken Shawarma with Chickpea Rice Pilaf
One Pot Chinese Chicken and Rice
One Pan Baked Chicken and Rice
Chicken and Rice Pilaf with Nuts and Dried Fruit
1 cup rice ((white rice - long grain, medium grain, short grain, Jasmin, basmati))
instruction_lines: Place water and rice in a medium saucepan over medium high heat.
Bring to a simmer so the entire surface is rippling.
Place tight fitting lid on, then reduce heat to medium low so it's simmering gently (or low for strong stoves).
Cook for 13 minutes - do not stir, do not remove lid.
Water should now be absorbed - QUICKLY tilt pot, lift lid to check.
Put lid back on, remove from stove, leave 10 minutes.
Remove lid, fluff with fork. Serve!
